subject: Invite acceptance failing — stale token + retry workflow
messages:
From: Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@novustrading.com>
To: priyom.das@redwood.com, priyamailbox@redwood.com
Cc: procure-support@acmeportal.com
Date: 2026-10-28T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Supplier portal invite — acceptance keeps spinning

Hi team,

We're seeing a batch of supplier invites from last week that never moved from the "Accept invitation" page. Users click the button and the page spins, eventually timing out with an error. We tried resending to a couple of addresses and same behavior.

Small sample of impacted emails attached (invite-backlog-20261028.csv). The affected users are all at Novus Trading Co. — procurement wanted to get them live before PO approvals tomorrow.

Relevant details:
- Portal: Coupa (hosted tenant ID: novus-coupa-82)
- First seen: 2026-10-26 14:00 UTC
- Error in browser console: 401 on /api/invites/accept with message "invalid or expired token"

Can you confirm whether invite tokens are expiring early (we saw tokens issued ~24h ago)? If there's a retry or fallback we can enable, please advise — procurement is on a deadline.

Thanks,
Anna Lopez
Sr. Procurement Ops
Novus Trading Co.

From: priyom.das@redwood.com <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@novustrading.com>, priyamailbox@redwood.com
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-28T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Supplier portal invite — acceptance keeps spinning

Hi Anna — thanks for the report and the CSV. I pulled the logs for tenant novus-coupa-82 and attached the SSO debug snippet (sso-debug-log-1028.txt).

Preliminary findings:
- The invite acceptance endpoint is receiving a JWT but our validation service rejects it with "iss mismatch" or "exp in past" in ~60% of samples.
- Tokens issued during 10/26–10/27 show shorter TTL (600s) than expected (we normally issue 24h). Root cause unclear — looks like a downstream config change in the invite generator service.

Short-term mitigation options:
1) Reissue invites from admin console — will give fresh tokens, manual and slow (we can batch a CSV run).
2) Enable a back-compat check on the acceptance endpoint to accept tokens with a leeway of 5 minutes until we roll a proper fix.
3) Fallback: surface a "Resend magic link" button that bypasses the current acceptance flow and sends a one-time link via email.

I'm going to coordinate with infra to confirm whether a recent deployment changed the default TTL. Monica — can you confirm whether we toggled any env var on the invite-gen Lambda around the 10/26 deployment window?

I'll keep this thread updated.

Best,
Priyom Das
Technical Program Manager, Onboarding
Redwood Inference

From: ben.carter@redwood.com <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: priyom.das@redwood.com, priyamailbox@redwood.com
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.com, anna.lopez@novustrading.com
Date: 2026-10-28T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Supplier portal invite — acceptance keeps spinning

Anna / Team — real time pressure here: Novus has 18 vendors that need portal access to approve POs tomorrow morning. Procurement has already paused PO processing until invites are accepted.

Requesting an ops-first mitigation we can ship in <4 hours and a postmortem plan:
- Can we run a CSV reissue targeted at the 18 high-priority emails? If so, please confirm ETA and whether we can run it as an opt-in admin action (so Novus's admins get the confirmation email).
- If reissue isn't possible quickly, please push option #2 (5m leeway) behind a feature flag we can toggle off once the token TTL is fixed. Put a short audit log entry so we can track affected invites.

If this needs an escalation to infra, @monica — please escalate and loop in @priya (CS lead) for customer comms.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales Manager
Redwood Inference

From: priyamailbox@redwood.com <priyamailbox@redwood.com>
To: ben.carter@redwood.com, priyom.das@redwood.com
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.com, Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@novustrading.com>, infra-oncall@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-29T16:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Supplier portal invite — acceptance keeps spinning

Team update and remediation plan (final):

Summary:
- Root cause: a canary deploy on 2026-10-26 accidentally set invite token TTL to 600s in the invite generator service. Tokens were intermittently valid due to clock skew between generator and validation.
- Impact: ~43 invites failed in tenant novus-coupa-82; 18 marked urgent by Novus procurement.

Actions taken (completed):
- Infra rolled back the canary and restored TTL to 24h at 2026-10-29T12:20:00-07:00.
- We executed a targeted reissue for the 18 priority emails — admin console batch job completed at 2026-10-29T14:05:00-07:00. Confirmation receipts were sent to Novus admins. (See invite-backlog-20261028.csv for mapping.)
- We deployed a short-term acceptance leeway of 5 minutes behind a feature flag while the rollback was validated (feature flag toggled off at 2026-10-29T15:30:00-07:00 after verification).

Next steps (postmortem / prevent recurrence):
- Postmortem doc: owner priyom.das — due 2026-11-03 — to include timeline, deploy checklist fixes, and a test that asserts TTL invariants. Link will be shared to the Drive folder.
- Add alerting on invite TTL anomalies and a unit test that prevents TTL drift during canary releases.
- Customer comms: Priya to send short note to Anna / procurement summarizing fix and offering a 1:1 to confirm vendor access.

Anna — apologies for the disruption. We prioritized your tenant and confirmed the 18 vendors can accept invites now. If anyone still sees an issue, reply here and we'll do a manual resend immediately.

Regards,
Priya Natarajan
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference
